description:
`jit doc check-links` captures the full bytes of every referenced document in one repository image, so it fails on a repository whose referenced documents total more than the capture byte budget. 55e3d3fd scoped the mutation, repair and validation captures; the link check was not in its scope.

## Background

- Observed in a downstream repository (gf2, at its 2c1ffe89a) with the installed binary built from e371e3a16, which contains 55e3d3fd: `jit doc check-links` fails after about two minutes with `Error: captured 7403685177 bytes but the maximum is 536870912`. `jit recover` and `jit validate` pass on the same tree. That repository references bench logs and receipts up to 60 MB (see 55e3d3fd's background).
- `read_documents_at_named_versions` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:1340`) captures through `capture_discovering` over `link_check_capture_spec` (`:1395`), bounded by `LINK_CHECK_CAPTURE_BUDGET` (`:39`, `max_bytes: CAPTURE_MAX_BYTES`).
- `link_check_capture_spec` requests, for each reference in scope, its working-tree entry and its pinned evidence. `DocumentReferenceRequests::for_reference` (`crates/jit/src/document/reference.rs:73`) makes an unpinned reference request both the working-tree file and its `HEAD` blob, so every unpinned document is read twice. All requested bytes accumulate in one image before any document is checked.
- From the image, `read_document` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:1508`) and `pinned_link_targets` (`:1475`) consume content only to scan a pinned reference for links; an unpinned reference is only resolved through `resolve_document_reference`, and its assets and links are checked against the working tree.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit doc check-links` succeeds on a repository whose referenced documents total more than the capture byte budget, and reports the same errors and warnings as before for every reference: a missing document, a broken link, a missing asset and a dangling pinned target are still reported.
- [hard] REQ-02: The link check reads a referenced document's content only where it consumes it, and does not read an unpinned reference's bytes twice (working tree and `HEAD`).
- [hard] REQ-03: One owning test proves that a link check over an issue whose referenced non-scanned document exceeds a small capture budget succeeds without reading that document's bytes.
title: Link checks read only the documents they scan for links
